Join our growing team at Vetcove, and help us transform how veterinarians buy the supplies they need to keep America's pets healthy. Vetcove's eCommerce and mobile platforms enable veterinary practices to compare and buy from all of their vendors in one place. Our community of more than 17,000 veterinary hospitals employs tens of thousands of veterinarians, and delivers care to many millions of animals every year across all 50 states. We’re a growing team on a mission to modernize the $50B+ animal health industry. Simply put, Vetcove helps veterinary organizations spend more time giving care, and less time shopping and comparing across vendors to supply their practices. Vetcove is a Y Combinator and venture-backed growth stage company with notable investors in Silicon Valley and NYC. We're looking for exceptionally talented and passionate people to join our growing team.

About Our Team

We move lightning-fast in an industry that was previously slow to adopt technology. As Vetcove quickly expands its offerings to better serve veterinary groups and their pet parents, we’re quickly growing our engineering team to keep pace with the rapid expansion of our business, while maintaining exceptional code quality and system integrity.

You’ll have an opportunity to work closely with end users, handle large scale infrastructure challenges, and everything in between.

About the Position

As an AI integration software engineer, you will be responsible for integrating cutting-edge LLM models from providers like OpenAI into our existing features to enhance our products' capabilities and deliver a better user experience.

Tools We Use:

We primarily use python and the Django web framework for powering our backend APIs and internal tooling.

Tech Stack: Python, Django, Elasticsearch, Postgres

Other Tools: Git, Docker

Primary responsibilities include:
• Evaluating and selecting the most appropriate AI models for our products based on our business needs and requirements.
• Developing and maintaining AI-powered application features using Python
• Testing and validating the performance of AI models in real-world scenarios and troubleshooting issues as they arise.
• Staying up-to-date with the latest advancements in AI technology and identifying opportunities for innovation within our products.
• Fine-tuning, evaluating, and iterating on LLM models in production
• Work directly with our CTO and engineering team, as well as across other functions to continuously evolve our platform and products

You should have
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
• At least 3 years of experience in software development, including experience in building a professionally successful production application in a modern web framework
• Strong knowledge of AI models, including natural language processing (NLP), machine learning (ML), and deep learning (DL)
• A passion for staying up to date with the latest developments in AI
• Strong engineering fundamentals with various back-end technologies
• Ability to design new features around data models with accuracy, security, and performance in mind
• A positive attitude and one-for-all team mentality

job_description:
About Robin AI

Robin AI is on a mission to revolutionize the legal industry by simplifying contracts and making law accessible to everyone. We utilize cutting-edge machine learning and contract software, enhancing traditional legal services and bringing together experts in engineering, AI, and law. Robin AI has recently raised $26m in Series B funding and has seen an impressive 5x revenue growth in the last 12 months.

We're looking for passionate, resourceful and collaborative people to join Robin. If you're motivated about leveraging technology to make essential business services more accessible, come join us!

About this role

Robin AI is looking for LLM Research Engineers to join a new Research and Development function in the company. Today our product uses large language models to help automate legal work. You will work to ensure that we continue to be at the cutting edge of LLM capabilities by working on LLM fine-tuning, retrieval augmented generation, and other technologies, and by identifying new possible LLM functionality we can build into our product.

You will report directly to the CTO and co-founder as part of a small, agile and cross-functional R&D team.

This role represents an opportunity to drive the medium and long term AI roadmap for a well-funded, fast growing legal AI start-up that is now emerging as a leader in the field.

What you’ll do
• Lead research projects aimed at improving the capabilities of the LLMs we use in our core product
• Prototype new functionality using LLMs
• Experiment with new ways our data can be used to improve the product and identify and acquire new sources of relevant data
• Be aware of and communicate the latest developments in AI
• Collaborate with our product and engineering team to help productionise the results of your research, and with partner organisations such as AWS and Anthropic
• Together with our prompt engineering team, act as a hub of expertise in LLM usage and best practice for the whole company

Qualifications
• Has exceptional ML engineering ability - evidence of which can include:
• Publications in top AI conferences
• Experience in ML engineering at elite AI research labs
• Experience in applied ML engineering or research in complex and high-stakes applications
• Major contributions to open source models or frameworks
• Strong experience in training, evaluating and deploying large AI models
• Experience in building products/projects using large language models (either open-source or commercial APIs)
• Deep knowledge of technical machine learning concepts, and related fields
• A scientific, hypothesis-driven mindset, and the ability to quickly build prototypes to test those hypotheses
• Adept at quickly building prototypes with Python and relevant ML frameworks
• A background working in a start-up or similar size organisation and a passion for building high-quality products
• Strong communication skills, and ability to distil technically complex concepts and data for an intelligent but non-ML audience

Compensation at Robin AI
• Salary: $200k - $450k
• Generous Equity package: When you help build Robin AI, everyone deserves to be an owner.
• Please Note: If your salary expectations look a little different to that outlined, we’d still be keen to hear from you if this is a role that excites you and one that you think you could really excel in.

We are able to offer visa transfer/extension.

Benefits at Robin AI

At Robin AI, we put humanity first - we believe a great product is inextricably linked to a great internal community.

We’re a quickly growing, cross-functional team that values supporting each other's development. As part of the team, you can expect:
• 15 days PTO, excluding national holidays, cultural leave, and birthday leave
• Medical Insurance
• Dental Insurance
• Vision Coverage
• Short and Long-term Disability
• Life Insurance
• 401k Retirement
• Flex spending and HSA
• Technology to enable you to work seamlessly from the office or home
• Focus on continual learning and development

Robin's flexible work model aims to meet the needs of our diverse employee community by making work more flexible, connected, and inclusive. Depending on the role and needs of the team, Robin employees have the flexibility to work from home 2/3 days per week.

Robin is deliberate about the culture we are building and are committed to creating an inclusive environment that attracts the best talent from diverse backgrounds. Whether it’s helping curate the Robin Spotify playlist, discussing gender equality in tech, or taking a meditation break with our holistic health plan, we want you to find your space within the Robin community.

From our offices in Lower Manhattan, New York, USA you’ll have access to all of the WeWork amenities including co-working space, bike lockers, pool tables, table tennis, free barista-made coffee and free beer in the evenings.

Diversity, equity and Inclusion at Robin AI

We want to break diversity, inclusion and equality barriers within the tech industry. In building our team, we welcome the unique contributions that you can bring, and welcome applications regardless of ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity and expression, disability, education, opinions, nation of origin, languages spoken, age, pregnancy and maternity, or veteran’s status. To request reasonable accommodation, we encourage you to communicate any reasonable accommodations you may need to your recruiter as you move forward.

Do you thrive in collaborative environments alongside talented colleagues who have a track record of founding, building, and successfully selling a 10 billion USD unicorn? If so, Dola AI is looking for a senior product manager to join our exceptional team!

We are seeking a highly motivated and dynamic Sr. Product Manager to join our innovative team. The Sr. Product Manager will play a pivotal role in supporting the product management team in all aspects of product development, from conceptualization to launch and beyond. The ideal candidate is passionate about technology, possesses strong analytical skills, and thrives in a fast-paced, collaborative environment. We're seeking a skilled communicator who values constructive feedback and excels within a small, experienced team.

If you're ready to contribute your expertise to an innovative AI-driven company with a dynamic team, we'd love to hear from you. Join us in shaping the future of AI at Dola AI!

The Role
• Assist in the development and execution of product strategies and roadmaps in alignment with company goals and market demands.
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams including engineering, design, marketing, and sales to define product requirements and priorities.
• Assist in the creation of product specifications, user stories, and other documentation to guide the development process.
• Conduct market research and analysis to identify customer needs, competitive landscape, and industry trends.
• Support the product development lifecycle, including feature prioritization, sprint planning, and user acceptance testing.
• Monitor and analyze key performance indicators (KPIs) to evaluate product performance and identify areas for improvement.
• Assist in the preparation of product-related presentations, reports, and materials for internal and external stakeholders.
• Provide support for customer inquiries, feedback, and product-related issues, ensuring timely resolution and customer satisfaction.
• Stay informed about emerging technologies, industry trends, and competitor activities to inform product decisions and strategies.
• Contribute to a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement within the product management team and across the organization.

• 5+ years of experience in product management, product marketing, or related roles, preferably in the technology industry.
• Strong analytical skills with the ability to gather and interpret data from multiple sources.
• Excellent communication skills with the ability to effectively communicate complex ideas and concepts.
• Proven ability to work collaboratively in a cross-functional team environment.
• Detail-oriented with strong organizational and time management skills.
• Passion for technology and a keen interest in artificial intelligence and its applications.
• Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and adapt to changing priorities.
• Experience with agile development methodologies is a plus.

Easier, smarter, and faster, Dola AI is the perfect personal assistant. We are very product-driven, spending the majority of our effort to making a perfect product. We also have a very flat, open culture, encouraging everyone to share their thoughts and opinions on how to take things to the next level.

• Work with Bungie's in-house character creation and data editing tools to create new characters, weapons, attacks, and abilities

• Troubleshoot, debug, and fix AI behavior and performances

• Experience in Animation; able to talk anticipation, follow through, character and timing

job_title: Senior Director AI/ML Engineering, Responsible Use of AI Program - Remote
job_description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by diversity and inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health equity on a global scale. Join us to start Caring. Connecting. Growing together.

The Optum AI team is focused on delivering AI-ML solutions for the highest impact and business prioritized problems. Across UnitedHealth Group, we are transforming the health care journey through responsible AI/ML innovation that; simplifies operations and reduce administrative burden; improves the member and provider experience; and brings insights and information to clinicians. Driving Responsible use of AI across the enterprise to ensure safe deployment of AI models into practice is a key focus of Optum AI as well as enabling democratization of AI by creating platform capabilities and frameworks for developers across the enterprise.

As artificial intelligence and machine learning (AI/ML) solutions continue to evolve, we are committed to assessing and improving our AI/ML practices continuously based on our own learning, industry best practices and regulatory guidance. Our Responsible Use of AI program, which includes the Machine Learning Review Board, supports all ML teams across UnitedHealth Group (UHG) with a holistic, structured, and cross-disciplined review of AI.

In this leadership role, the Senior Director Data Science for the Responsible Use of AI Program (RUAI), you will be collaborating with other data science and AI-ML leaders to develop technical standards for Responsible AI development and evaluation and translate them into action through the implementation of ML model metrics and monitoring tools. You will apply your expertise in reviewing, assessing, and testing AI used across the organization through several workstreams. You will implement a framework for red-teaming and conducting independent assessment and testing of internal AI and support M & A diligence efforts. You will participate in internal AI governance processes by reviewing internal or supplier-provided AI and oversee external/independent assessments of internal AI. As a key leader in the Responsible Use of AI program, you will influence across the enterprise by interacting with data science leaders and functional business executives to educate and advise on key concepts related to responsible use of AI. This role is essential to the company's success as the RUAI program has increasing requirements for standards based on emerging technology and to meet the increasing market demand.

As the Senior Director, you will drive the implementation and adoption of state-of-the-art evaluation metrics for Generative AI and other modern AI methods as well as drive the frameworks and evaluation process for measuring the safety, accuracy, and fairness of ML model implementation. You will provide leadership to, and will be accountable for, the adoption and consistent use of standardized AI measurement and monitoring frameworks and tools. This role reports to the Director of the Responsible Use of AI Program and working with the UHG Chief AI Officer.

To be successful in this role, you will bring solid analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills, with the ability to balance innovation and pragmatism to drive the team and solutions forward, possess an educator's voice to support organizational growth and maturity, and promote a keen passion for learning and continuous improvement based on the latest AI/ML trends and research.

Please note that this role is not intended for professionals performing the following work: less complex analysis on small data sets; rules-based algorithmic or descriptive analytics; development of big data infrastructure.

You'll enjoy the flexibility to work remotely * from anywhere within the U.S. as you take on some tough challenges.

Primary Responsibilities:
• Research and develop new methods to build, test and monitor AI consistent with UHG guiding principles for Responsible Use of AI (quality, explainability, fairness, security, accountability, and continuous improvement)
• Design and build new tools to implement AI performance and fairness testing and monitoring in partnership with legal, compliance, and engineering teams
• Play a key leadership role in the Machine Learning Review Board to provide direct oversight and review of proposed AI from teams across Optum, UHG and UHC (UnitedHealthcare)
• Conduct Red Team/adversarial reviews of AI used by UHC, Optum or UHG
• Identify and manage third party AI assessors (e.g., consultants) as they perform third-party reviews of UHG AI
• Lead AI due diligence in support of M&A efforts
• Manage a small, dedicated team with the ability to utilize development engineers, SMEs, and other resources to achieve goals

You'll be rewarded and recognized for your performance in an environment that will challenge you and give you clear direction on what it takes to succeed in your role as well as provide development for other roles you may be interested in.

Required Qualifications:
• Master's degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics, statistics, or a related STEM discipline
• 12 years of experience in Software Engineering, Data Science, or Analytics with 8 years of experience in AI/ML solution development
• 8 years of expertise in various AI/ML techniques, such as deep learning, natural language processing, computer vision, recommender systems, reinforcement learning, large language models, etc.
• 4 years of experience in Python for data analysis and AI/ML development
• 4 years of experience leading and managing (direct reports and dotted line) AI/ML teams including driving projects, from ideation to delivery and evaluation
• 2 years of experience evaluating the performance and fairness of AI following internal or external guidelines for responsible development and use of AI

Preferred Qualifications:
• Ph.D. in computer science, engineering, mathematics, or statistics
• Proven track record of delivering high-impact AI/ML solutions for real-world problems and use cases
• Experience in establishing and enforcing AI/ML best practices, standards, and ethics through development of technical frameworks and tools
• Background in Healthcare (AI)
• Portfolio of AI/ML publications, patents, or awards
• Experience in AI or data governance
• Experience in working with cross-functional and distributed teams in a global and diverse environment
• Experience in mentoring, coaching, and developing AI/ML talent
• All employees working remotely will be required to adhere to UnitedHealth Group's Telecommuter Policy.

California, Colorado, Connecticut, Hawaii, Nevada, New Jersey, New York, Rhode Island, Washington, DC or Washington Residents Only: The salary range for this role is $147,300 to $282,800 annually. Pay is based on several factors including but not limited to local labor markets, education, work experience, certifications, etc. UnitedHealth Group complies with all minimum wage laws as applicable. In addition to your salary, UnitedHealth Group offers benefits such as, a comprehensive benefits package, incentive and recognition programs, equity stock purchase and 401k contribution (all benefits are subject to eligibility requirements). No matter where or when you begin a career with UnitedHealth Group, you'll find a far-reaching choice of benefits and incentives.

Application Deadline: This will be posted for a minimum of 2 business days or until a sufficient candidate pool has been collected. Job posting may come down early due to volume of applicants.

At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone-of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income-deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes - an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.

Diversity creates a healthier atmosphere: UnitedHealth Group is an Equal Employment Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, protected veteran status, disability status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by law.

UnitedHealth Group is a drug - free workplace. Candidates are required to pass a drug test before beginning employment.

In pursuit of a Principal Generative AI Developer. We require a candidate with a wealth of experience devising and maintaining APIs and SDKs, enabling scale of AI models that form a key part of our Enterprise AI team. You will be assigned to create systems that grant public access to LLMs and FMs via our cloud infrastructure, alongside a team of elite AI researchers and engineers. Our key collaboration with you will be to develop APIs for customer applications that will operate in real-time.

Responsibilities of Principal Generative AI Developer:
• Architect, construct, and implement properly-managed primary APIs and SDKs to get into our LLMs and exclusive FMs, which comprise exercises for training, refining, and promoting, and even orchestration SDKs.
• Build APIs with clear documentation and standardized protocols that support governance automation, minimizing the potential for errors and security breaches.
• Build interfaces with LLMs and FMs that integrate seamlessly into your application and provide enhanced functionality for your users.
• Allow our users to develop brand-new GenAI functionalities.
• Effective tools and processes for monitoring API access patterns and operational health will help identify potential vulnerabilities and provide prompt remedial measures.
• Implement strict governance processes that ensure AI is developed in line with ethical principles, legal regulations, and stakeholder expectations.

• Pursuing a four-year degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical discipline, culminating in a Bachelor's degree
• A requirement for the position is having an extensive background in designing and constructing data-driven solutions with a strong emphasis on cache optimization and distributed computing techniques that spans 6 years or more

• We are seeking candidates who have experience constructing, scaling, and optimizing training or inferencing systems for deep neural networks for at least one year

• Competency in building and managing AI-powered products or platforms for NLP, speech, computer vision, or recommendation systems aimed at serving massive user bases.

Sr Distinguished Engineer, Generative AI Systems

Our mission at Capital One is to create trustworthy, reliable and human-in-the-loop AI systems, changing banking for good. For years, Capital One has been leading the industry in using machine learning to create real-time, intelligent, automated customer experiences. From informing customers about unusual charges to answering their questions in real time, our applications of AI & ML are bringing humanity and simplicity to banking. Because of our investments in public cloud infrastructure and machine learning platforms, we are now uniquely positioned to harness the power of AI. We are committed to building world-class applied science and engineering teams and continue our industry leading capabilities with breakthrough product experiences and scalable, high-performance AI infrastructure. At Capital One, you will help bring the transformative power of emerging AI capabilities to reimagine how we serve our customers and businesses who have come to love the products and services we build.

We are looking for an experienced Senior Distinguished Engineer, AI Systems, to help us build the foundations of our enterprise AI Capabilities. You will work on a wide range of initiatives, whether that’s designing robust, secure infrastructure, building large-scale distributed training clusters, deploying LLMs on GPU instances for real-time use cases, or supporting cutting-edge AI research and development, all in our public cloud infrastructure. You will work with a team of AI engineers and researchers to envision the target state of our capabilities while helping to design and implement key services. Examples of projects you will work on include:
• Design and build fault-tolerant infrastructure to support long-running large-scale training tasks reliably despite failure of individual nodes, using containers and check-pointing libraries.
• Design and build infrastructure for serving large ML models, in our public cloud.
• Deploy a thousand-node training cluster optimizing storage and networking stack, with tightly coupled training pipelines to take advantage of multiple parallelism strategies, in our public cloud.
• Design and implement benchmarks to measure the performance of software systems within AI capabilities and make recommendations on technology selection
• Develop applications that leverage LLMs and FMs.
• Design and implement capabilities to support MLOps for foundation models.

Capital One is open to hiring a Remote Employee for this opportunity

Basic Qualifications:
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering or a technical field
• At least 9 years of experience designing and building distributed computing HPC and large-scale ML systems
• At least 6 years of experience developing AI and ML algorithms in Python or C/C++
• At least 3 years of experience with the full ML development lifecycle using AI and ML frameworks and public cloud.

Preferred Qualifications:
• Master’s degree or PhD in Engineering, Computer Science, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience with a focus on modern AI techniques.
• Experience designing large-scale distributed platforms and/or systems in cloud environments such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
• Experience architecting cloud systems for security, availability, performance, scalability, and cost.
• Experience with delivering very large models through the MLOps life cycle from exploration to serving.
• Experience with building GPU clusters in the public cloud with tightly-coupled storage and networking.
• Experience with the complete stack for distributed training of large models including ML compilers, distributed training frameworks, and ML development frameworks such as Pytorch, Tensorflow, Lightning etc.
• Experience with one or multiple areas of AI technology stack including prompt engineering, guardrails, vector databases/knowledge bases, LLM hosting and fine-tuning.
• Authored research publications in top peer-reviewed conferences, or industry-recognized contributions in the space of neural networks, distributed training and SysML.

job_description:
Job Summary of Senior Generative AI Product Engineer:

This position will be tasked with creating products that take advantage of the latest developments in AI, making it an exciting time to be a part of this team

At the heart of Capital One's values is creating trustworthy, dependable, and human-led AI systems in the banking industry. Capital One has been leading the industry in its use of machine learning to produce intelligent, automated customer experiences in real-time. Capital One platforms are designed to provide personalized banking services that address customers' inquiries, inform them of unusual charges, and provide a human touch. Capital One is well-equipped to realize AI's potential, and its investments in public cloud infrastructure and machine learning platforms, coupled with its world-class applied science and engineering teams, have provided breakthrough products and scalable, high-performance AI infrastructure. Joining Capital One allows you to unleash the full potential of emerging AI capabilities, thereby reimagining banking for the future.

We need an experienced Senior Generative AI Product Engineer to help develop and maintain APIs and SDKs as part of our Enterprise AI team. Your responsibility involves building systems enabling public access to LLMs and FMs through our cloud environment. Collaborating with a team of expert AI engineers and researchers, you will design and implement important API products and services for user-facing applications operating in real-time.

Responsibilities of Senior Generative AI Product Engineer:
• Establish, erect, and put into operation well-managed primary APIs and SDKs that provide access to our LLMs and proprietary FMs, which includes training, fine-tuning, and prompting exercises, together with orchestration SDKs.
• Implement caching mechanisms to improve API performance and reduce latency when processing high volumes of data.
• Leverage LLMs and FMs to craft specialized interfaces that deliver a personalized experience to your customers and associates.
• Facilitate the creation of new GenAI capabilities by our users.
• Ensuring API access patterns and operational health are maintained at optimum levels entails deploying tools and processes that can extract the necessary metrics and analyze trends.
• Devise and test approaches for model validation, performance monitoring, and risk assessment to enhance model accuracy and robustness.

Basic Qualifications of Senior Generative AI Product Engineer:
• Completing a program of study in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a similar technical field lasting a minimum of four years and leading to a Bachelor's degree
• The position necessitates a wealth of experience in developing and engineering data-intensive solutions that utilize cache optimization and distributed computing approaches, acquired through a minimum of six years in the industry
• The ideal candidate should have a programming background of at least 6 years in Java, Go, Scala, or Python
• A minimum of one year of hands-on experience in creating, streamlining, and enhancing training or inferencing systems for deep neural networks is expected for this role

Preferred Qualifications of Senior Generative AI Product Engineer:
• Skill in constructing and launching AI-powered products or platforms that can handle millions of users for NLP, speech, recommendation systems, and computer vision.
• Showing proficiency in coping with uncertain circumstances and competing demands.
• Applicants with a history in tech and product-based companies/startups are preferred.
• The proficiency to collaborate with researchers and engineers in rapidly iterating and improving the product while concurrently developing foundational capabilities.
• Skill in implementing demanding production requirements for large neural network models.
• Demonstrated proficiency in API security, system observability, and cloud access control, as well as knowledge of privacy best practices.

Our mission at Capital One is to create trustworthy, reliable and human-in-the-loop AI systems, changing banking for good. For years, Capital One has been leading the industry in using machine learning to create real-time, intelligent, automated customer experiences. From informing customers about unusual charges to answering their questions in real time, our applications of AI & ML are bringing humanity and simplicity to banking. Because of our investments in public cloud infrastructure and machine learning platforms, we are now uniquely positioned to harness the power of AI. We are committed to building world-class applied science and engineering teams and continue our industry leading capabilities with breakthrough product experiences and scalable, high-performance AI infrastructure. At Capital One, you will help bring the transformative power of emerging AI capabilities to reimagine how we serve our customers and businesses who have come to love the products and services we build.

We are looking for an experienced Lead Engineer, Generative AI Infrastructure to help us build the foundations of our AI capabilities. You will work on a wide range of initiatives, whether that’s building large-scale distributed training clusters, or deploying LLMs on GPU instances for real-time applications and decisioning systems, or supporting cutting-edge AI research and development, all in our public cloud infrastructure. You will work closely with our cloud and container infrastructure teams as well as our world-class team of AI researchers to design and implement key capabilities. Examples of projects you will work on:
• Deploy a thousand-node training cluster optimizing storage and networking stack, with tightly coupled training pipelines to take advantage of multiple parallelism strategies, in our public cloud.
• Design and build fault-tolerant infrastructure to support long-running large-scale training tasks reliably despite failure of individual nodes, using containers and check-pointing libraries.
• Design and build run-time infrastructure for serving large ML models such as LLMs and FMs in our public cloud.
• Build infrastructure for deploying search indexes and embeddings in vector databases that will work closely with the rest of our capabilities.

Capital One is open to hiring a Remote Employee for this opportunity

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering or a technical field
• At least 6 years of experience designing and building data-intensive solutions using distributed computing
• At least 6 years of experience programming with Python, Go, Scala, or Java
• At least 1 year of experience with HPCs, vector embedding, or semantic search technologies
• At least 1 years of experience building, scaling, and optimizing training or inferencing systems for deep neural networks

• Master's or Doctoral degree in Computer science, Computer Engineering, Electrical engineering, Mathematics, or a similar field.
• Background in machine learning with experience in large scale training and deployment of deep neural nets and/or transformer architectures.
• Experience with machine learning frameworks such as TensorFlow or Pytorch, Lightning, Mosaic ML etc.
• Ability to move fast in an environment with ambiguity at times, and with competing priorities and deadlines.
• Experience at tech and product-driven companies/startups preferred.
• Ability to iterate rapidly with researchers and engineers to improve a product experience while building the foundational capabilities.
• Familiarity with deploying large neural network models in demanding production environments.
• Experience with building GPU clusters in the public cloud with tightly-coupled storage and networking.
